products.name: Professional Application Tracker
products.problem: Losing track of applications, role restrictions and follow-ups
products.benefit: Track eligibility, application progress, contact and deadlines
steps: Verify location eligibility before investing time in an application.
Tailor your CV to the role using truthful achievements.
Review your next-action column each workday.

products.claim: Tracker and guidance, not guaranteed employment.

products.name: Weekly Focus Planner
products.benefit: A daily priority and reflection routine
steps: Choose a maximum of three meaningful priorities each day.
Reserve time for one critical task first.
Close the day by recording one completed result.
products.hook: A smaller daily plan is easier to execute.

products.name: AI Workflow Quality-Control Kit
products.problem: Using AI outputs without source or quality checks
products.benefit: Structure prompts, source checks, review and approvals
rows: Draft a concise FAQ based only on supplied facts
steps: Define the input data and the limits of AI authority.
Review evidence, clarity, and permissions before reuse.
Record every release decision for accountability.
products.hook: AI output needs a quality gate before publication.
products.claim: Workflow documentation, not a hosted or autonomous AI agent.

products.name: Small Business Proposal Toolkit
products.problem: Inconsistent scopes, milestones and change controls
products.benefit: Structure an offer, scope, commercial assumptions and acceptance criteria
steps: Define the client problem using their own terms.
Describe what is included and excluded from the quoted work.
Agree acceptance evidence before project execution.
products.hook: A good proposal defines how both sides measure delivery.
products.claim: Operational template, not legal or accounting advice.

products.name: Service Pricing Workbook
products.problem: Quoting projects without knowing delivery cost
products.benefit: Estimate effort, direct cost, contingency and proposed price
steps: Replace the cost inputs with verified figures.
Change target margin and inspect the output.
Compare your quote with customer value, market context and delivery risk.
products.hook: Price your work after understanding the cost of delivery.
products.claim: Illustrative pricing worksheet, not a guarantee of profitability.

products.name: One-Page Business Website Starter
products.problem: A homepage that fails to explain the offer
products.benefit: Start with a fast mobile-responsive service page
steps: Replace the sample business name and services with original facts.
Check layout on mobile and desktop.
Set a real contact destination and publish only after testing.
products.hook: Give visitors one offer and one clear next step.

products.name: Minimal Business Icon Kit
products.benefit: A coordinated set of original editable SVG icons
steps: Use supplied original SVG icons in consistent sizes.
Change stroke color to match your brand.
Review contrast and icon meaning for accessibility.
products.hook: Cleaner visuals help people understand the next action.
products.claim: Original vector assets, not copied brand symbols.

products.name: Practical Microcourse Planner
products.problem: Training materials without measurable learning outcomes
products.benefit: Plan lessons, exercises and knowledge checks
rows: Write the problem in one sentence
steps: Write a measurable outcome for each lesson.
Add worked examples and a learner exercise.
Pilot the lesson with a learner before claiming training results.
products.hook: A useful short course starts with one measurable outcome.
products.claim: Course-building starter template, not a prerecorded course.
